summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing for CampusConnect. 22/22 pytest backend cases passed. End-to-end Playwright UI flows verified for student, teacher and admin: login, dashboard stats, grades + chart, timetable (5 days), payments + Stripe redirect, library borrow/return, messaging send, notifications read-all, logout, teacher add-grade dialog. No critical issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: Sidebar navigation uses testid 'nav-messaging' (not 'nav-messages'); the original test request mentioned generic nav-* — review_request hint was slightly inaccurate but UI is correct.
/api/payments/checkout correctly ignores any amount sent from client and reads it from the fee document (server.py line 246) — secure.
MongoDB ObjectId properly stripped via clean() helper; no `_id` exposed in any API response (verified).
JWT secret, Stripe key, CORS origins all read from env. bcrypt hashes generated with $2b$ prefix.
Public payment_status endpoint requires auth (good); webhook also implemented.
Teacher dashboard correctly shows stats (Étudiants/Enseignants/Cours/Livres); the add-grade-button lives on the Notes (/notes) page for teachers, which is acceptable UX.
Console: minor warning about <link rel=preload> unsupported `as` value — cosmetic, not blocking.
Consider rate-limit / brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (no lockout currently).
seed_data_creation: Tests created TEST_Course/TEST_Quiz grade and TEST_UI_Course/TEST_UI_Quiz grade for the seeded student via teacher account; also one TEST_MSG_<ts> message and a transient borrow/return on Introduction aux algorithmes (returned at end of run for that book). No persistent destructive changes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, 22 tests, ~5s). Use BASE_URL from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Frontend sidebar testids: nav-dashboard, nav-grades, nav-timetable, nav-payments, nav-library, nav-messaging, nav-notifications, logout-button. Add-grade dialog testids: add-grade-button, grade-student-select, grade-course-input, grade-title-input, grade-score-input, grade-coef-input, grade-submit-button (all on /notes page when role=teacher). Messaging: contact-<id>, message-input, send-message-button. Stripe redirect confirmed to checkout.stripe.com domain.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs reproduced; all 10 features in the review request behave correctly.
